entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6070080754075553792 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0. Gaia DR3 source 6070080754075553792: parallax 9.3031 +/- 0.0346 mas (RUWE 1.08), inverted to 107.4912 pc with no zero-point correction. Gaia DR3 source 6070080754075553792: pmRA* -33.9213 mas/yr, pmDec -18.9174 mas/yr. Gaia DR3 source 6070080754075553792: 9.77 +/- 0.71 km/s. Chauvin et al. (2017, Table 1) measured -5.2 +/- 1.3 km/s; the star rotates at v sin i 299 km/s, which broadens its lines and makes either value uncertain.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: The Gaia DR3 BP/RP sampled spectrum of source 6070080754075553792 (De Angeli et al. 2023, A&A 674, A2; Montegriffo et al. 2023, A&A 674, A3), weighted by the CIE 1931 2° colour-matching functions (CIE 2019, CC BY-SA 4.0). No image of the star's surface exists.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 computes from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 8,840 K and log g 4.23: a model, since no fit of this star's limb exists.
